defaults_assumed.default: No authentication in this iteration. The endpoints are designed so an API-key dependency can be added later on the /api router without changing the contract. Recorded as a risk.
Global scope, no expiry in this iteration. A replay with the same payload returns 201 and the identical body plus 'Idempotent-Replayed: true'. A different payload returns 409.
Not supported. Random codes only, no expiry.
Use the NFR-4 targets. Click recording is synchronous, in the same request.
Last 30 days by default (configurable with 'days'), top 10 referrers, and total_clicks counted all-time.
Use the socket peer address (request.client.host). Ignore X-Forwarded-For unless a future TRUSTED_PROXIES setting is added.
